label: Did this participant have a low score (<= -1.5 z-score) on the Logical Memory Delayed recall test? - Insight46 phase 1
meta_rows: Did this participant have a low score (<= -1.5 z-score) on the Logical Memory Delayed recall test? - Insight46 phase 1

Insight46 phase 1 mild cognitive impairment (MCI) / dementia consensus. Objective evidence of  an amnestic deficit (Logical Memory delayed recall ≥ 1.5 SD below the mean). This cognitive test was chosen for defining a cognitive deficit on the basis of its normal distribution across the entire cohort. Also collected during phase 2 - see library file I46P2_NeuroPsyc_MMSE.
cat_rows: This category contains information on self-reported personal history of neurological disoder; consensus assessment of mild cognitive impairment and dementia of the participants in the Insight46 sub-study.
freq_note: Missing values have been excluded, and categories with low cell counts have been suppressed, from both the plot and the counts above.
